nodes.label: COMPLETE_DATABASE_FIX.md — Prepared Statement Error Resolution
nodes.rationale: Supabase pgBouncer pooler (port 6543) caches prepared statements, causing 42P05 conflicts in serverless (Next.js). Fix: switch to direct connection port 5432, add disconnect+retry error recovery to every Prisma method. Rationale — serverless connection churn is incompatible with pgBouncer statement caching.
nodes.community_name: RAG Chatbot v2 Full Rewrite Plan

nodes.label: DATABASE_FIX.md — Database Connection Fix Summary
nodes.rationale: Same 42P05 prepared-statement root cause. Solution: DATABASE_URL on port 5432 (direct) instead of 6543 (pooler), simplified Prisma global singleton. Key takeaway: serverless + pgBouncer = broken prepared statements.
nodes.community_name: RAG Chatbot v2 Full Rewrite Plan

nodes.label: DATABASE_PRISMA.md — Prisma + Supabase Setup
nodes.rationale: Migration from SQLite to Prisma/PostgreSQL. Chat and Message models with CUID ids, JSON sources field, async DatabaseService. Production-ready with connection pooling.

nodes.label: Global Prisma Instance Pattern
nodes.rationale: In serverless, reuse PrismaClient across warm invocations via globalThis to avoid exhausting connection pools. Set in dev mode only to prevent hot-reload leaks.

nodes.label: NEON_CONFIGURATION.md — Neon Database Config
nodes.rationale: Three Neon connection tiers: pooled (queries), direct (migrations), unpooled (batch). Stack Auth optional integration. Best practice: pooled for most app queries, direct for schema changes.

nodes.label: PGVECTOR_MIGRATION.md — Qdrant to pgvector Migration
nodes.rationale: Migration from external Qdrant vector DB to pgvector inside PostgreSQL. Benefits: single DB, ACID across relational+vector data, simpler deployment, reduced latency. Uses OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (1536-dim), cosine similarity via pgvector <=> operator, threshold 0.7.

nodes.label: RAG Chatbot v2 Full Rewrite Plan
nodes.rationale: Complete v2 rewrite. Goals: Better Auth (email/password), assistant-ui chat, floating Help Scout-style widget, collection-based knowledge org, AI SDK v7 source streaming, structured [N] citations, DeepSeek v4 pro chat + OpenAI embeddings. pgvector cosine ≥0.6, top-8, dedup. Zustand for cross-surface sync. Fresh DB — no migration of existing data. Delete all dead code (Qdrant, Neon, old chat components, Kibo-UI).
